desk.summary: Two games are still to tip (76ers at Knicks 7:00 PM ET, Thunder at Spurs 9:30 PM ET; Celtics at Pistons has tipped). One selection clears the bar: the Knicks moneyline at DraftKings 1.556, where the desk makes NY 66% against a 64% break-even; the Thunder-Spurs game and every spread, total and player prop on the slate fail the price, probability or confirmation tests, so the section is short by design.

notes: Tip 9:30 PM ET at Frost Bank Center. Feed (DraftKings via ESPN): SA +1.5 at 1.87, OKC -1.5 at 1.952, SA moneyline 1.909 and OKC 1.909, total 230.5 (1.91 each side assumed on the board).

Third-party DraftKings-labelled page (Dimers) shows Spurs -1.5 at -102 and an unlabelled 233.5 total, which disagrees with the feed on the favourite. The spread line could not be confirmed, so no spread selection is made.

Injury report: SA Tobias Harris OUT (calf strain), Jayden Quaintance OUT (knee surgery); OKC Nikola Topic OUT (back surgery), Thomas Sorber OUT (knee surgery), Otega Oweh OUT (Achilles). Victor Wembanyama and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander carry no injury designation on the Oct 19 feed or the Oct 20 Thunder Wire report.
The model's game total is 224.4 for both games on tonight's slate, identical to PHI-NY, so the model total is treated as a placeholder and no total is taken.

No shootaround or same-day minutes note for either side was found; Harris's absence is taken from the report, with the rotation minutes that would shift to Keldon Johnson and Julian Champagnie unconfirmed.

selections.label: NY moneyline
inputs: DraftKings NY moneyline 1.556 (-180): the feed and the Bettor's Insider DraftKings column agree
PHI Oct 20 report: Fall OUT, Barlow OUT, Bona and Simons day-to-day; NY no injuries listed
Model: NY home win 0.7526 from a margin of +8.6 (ratings with zero games this season, so partly prior)
No-vig market NY 0.616 (1/1.556 and 1/2.50, overround removed)
arithmetic: Shrink toward market, weight 0.35 (zero games played this season): 0.6164 + 0.35 × (0.7526 − 0.6164) = 0.664, written as 0.66
Distance from no-vig: 0.66 − 0.616 = 4.4 points (inside the 8-point band, no re-check trigger)
pros: Home court and a model margin of +8.6 point the same way
PHI are missing two bench bigs (Fall, Barlow) and have two day-to-day guards and a day-to-day big (Simons, Bona, Wade)
NY carry no injury on the Oct 20 report
risks: Ratings are untested: zero games this season, so the 0.75 model number could be off by several points
Simons and Bona are day-to-day with no same-day minutes note; if both play, PHI's depth is closer to full strength
The edge is small (about 4 points over no-vig): a single late scratch on NY would remove it
selections.verdict: Knicks moneyline at DraftKings 1.556 (-180): the desk makes NY 66% against a 64.3% break-even and a 61.6% no-vig market. A small positive edge, graded B on partial evidence.

best.rule: the selections with the strongest evidence of winning, one per player, at most two per game

availability.label: Availability: the official injury report, shootaround and beat-writer notes, who starts

minutes.label: Minutes: recent rotation, blowout risk from the spread, back-to-back rest

matchup.label: Matchup: opponent defensive rating, pace, who guards whom, rim protection

usage_form.label: Usage and form, last ten games: shots, usage rate, assists per 36, rebound rate

lineup_shifts.label: Lineup shifts: who inherits minutes and shots when a starter sits

game_script.label: Game script: spread, total, pace, overtime risk

desk_config.note: Settings the NBA research desk follows on every scheduled run, and the defaults the page's Desk settings panel starts from.
